title: Review the approved interface for fidelity and accessibility
description:
Problem/Goal: assess the implementation against authoritative sources.
Key actions: inspect states, viewports, evidence, accessibility, and protected paths.
Out of scope: production code changes.
Success criteria: structured review decision and violations are recorded.
objective: Produce a decision-ready UX fidelity review.
result: Approved or changes_requested decision with structured violations.
acceptance_criteria: The review includes a decision and criterion-linked violations with severity and evidence.
